name: North River Nature Camp
description_short: A Mass Audubon nature day camp at the 225-acre North River Wildlife Sanctuary in Marshfield for children ages 4.5–14, Monday–Friday 9:00 am–3:00 pm. Campers in small age groups explore weekly nature themes through hikes, hands-on activities, games and crafts; ages 12–14 take specialty theme weeks.
activities: Specialty weeks for ages 12-14 (solar/STEM projects, wilderness skills, fossils)
